
---
applyTo: **/*.ts, **/*.tsx
---

# Next.js: ALWAYS read docs before coding
Before writing or modifying any Next.js code (pages, API routes, middleware, config, data-fetching), you must:

1. Check if docs exists
2. Identify the specific feature (routing, caching, middleware, etc.)
3. Read the matching doc file before writing code
4. If no docs exist → fetch from https://nextjs.org/docs
5. If no matching doc can be identified → stop and ask the user rather than rely on my training data
